verdict.rationale: Fivetran is a managed SaaS whose pre-built connectors are configured through the dashboard. Some code-first paths exist: custom connectors can be written in Python with the Connector SDK and deployed, transformation models can be imported into your own dbt project, and accounts and pipelines can be managed programmatically through the REST API. However, nothing shows that standard pipeline definitions live as versioned config in your repository, and portability is limited because pipelines run as Fivetran-hosted extensions. Missing for 10: declarative config-as-code or IaC (e.g., a Terraform provider) for standard connectors, a documented Git or code-review workflow, portability of pipelines outside Fivetran, and independent corroboration.
